acceptance: Accepted 2026-07-28 via DEC-0006 (GATE-0002 passed). This artifact now owns its enumerations; the canonical pack remains the prose explanation. Changes flow through ADRs and supersession.
sensitive_source_rules: Private source material is preserved separately from public canon and restricted by default.
Fictionalization or generalization of sensitive-source material requires explicit review.
Consent state and prohibited identifiers are recorded per source.
Sensitive source text is excluded from providers unless policy explicitly allows it.
Automatic reuse of sensitive-source material across properties is blocked.
limitation: Rights checks are evidence and workflow controls, not legal guarantees.
